title: dasyphyllum horridum
intro: Dasyphyllum horridum, commonly known as the "tree of the poor" due to its use in traditional medicine, is a shrub-like plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiparasitic properties, making it a valuable resource for treating various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dasyphyllum horridum include wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial activity, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds have been found to possess antioxidant, antiproliferative, and anti-inflammatory activities, contributing to the plant's medicinal properties.
